title: pandas and data analysis
description: Conventions for pandas and data analysis.

rules.title: Vectorize
rules.text: Use vectorized operations instead of iterating rows with iterrows or apply.

rules.title: Avoid chained assignment
rules.text: Use .loc for assignment and avoid chained indexing.

rules.title: Explicit dtypes
rules.text: Specify dtypes when reading data and validate schemas at load time.

rules.title: Reproducible analysis
rules.text: Fix random seeds, pin library versions and keep raw data immutable.

rules.title: Columnar storage
rules.text: Store intermediate data as Parquet instead of CSV.
